description.narrative: IMCC and MSAKE has been in a partnership for 8 years now. Coming to the conclusion that our partnership exceeds beyond the funding periods from partnership project to partnership project we wish to engage in a partnership development in order to set a common framework and discuss proper project management. The main aim of the Partnership Development project is to clarify and develop on the existing communication and project management structures within the two groups in our partnership. The Partnership Development project is set to clarify, reevaluate and develop project roles, responsibilities and tools in use in the project, which will lead to a plan for operational changes within and between the Project Coordination Teams (PCTs) in Denmark and Kenya. Lastly, a more overall aim of the project is to strengthen familiarity between members and increase common drive and motivation.
